items.title: Mozambique’s Tax Authority is recruiting 650 staff to strengthen revenue collection and inspections
items.summary: Mozambique’s Tax Authority (AT) will recruit 650 staff nationwide, including tax officers and guards, to strengthen revenue collection, tax inspections and customs control, according to a recruitment notice consulted by Lusa on Thursday. The notice states that the AT is opening a public recruitment process to fill 650 vacancies, including 350 in the technical career… Source
items.why: The “Mozambique’s Tax Authority is recruiting 650 staff to strengthen revenue collection and inspections” opportunity has a responsible entity, a concrete action and a deadline that should be checked before applying.
items.action: Open the original notice for “Mozambique’s Tax Authority is recruiting 650 staff to strengthen revenue collection and inspections”, confirm the requirements and deadline, and prepare the requested documents.

note: Editorial radar: opportunities with an identified deadline remain visible until that date; notices without a deadline remain visible for 14 days only.
